prompt:
Create a SaaS dashboard UI for a Business Credit Builder platform. The dashboard should help entrepreneurs track business credit readiness, entity setup, banking, tradelines, net-30 accounts, credit monitoring, funding readiness, and action steps.
Visual style: modern fintech dashboard with clean white cards, dark sidebar, green progress bars, status badges, and bento-grid modules.
Strong hook: “Build Business Credit Like a System, Not a Guessing Game.”
Hero message: “Track your entity foundation, business banking, credit accounts, tradelines, and funding readiness from one command center.”
CTA: “Start Building Business Credit”
Sections needed:
- Sidebar navigation
- Credit readiness score
- Entity foundation checklist
- Banking setup status
- Tradeline tracker
- Net-30 vendor tracker
- Funding readiness module
- Recommended next actions
- Document vault preview
- CTA card
Generate dashboard-style static files.
